# Compatible-product marks

Used only to identify the product a TableIQ profile connects to. Trademarks belong to their owners.

- Simple Icons (CC0), filled with each brand's listed hex: mariadb, tidb, doris (apachedoris), polardbx (alibabacloud), planetscale, vitess, cockroachdb (cockroachlabs), neon, supabase, timescaledb (timescale), alloydb + cloudsql-* (googlecloud). simple-icons 16.36.0.
- Devicon (MIT) `-original.svg`: redshift + rds-* (amazonwebservices), azure-* (azure), yugabytedb. devicon 2.18.0.
- Vendor sites: materialize (materialize.com/favicon.svg), selectdb (selectdb.com/favicon.svg).
- Vendor GitHub organisation avatars (128 px): questdb, risingwave (risingwavelabs), starrocks (StarRocks), oceanbase, dolt (dolthub), manticore (manticoresoftware), greatsql (GreatSQL), opengauss (opengauss-mirror).

Retrieved 2026-10-29.
